answer: Pair each identity secretly with another to watch, then re-pair unpredictably. If one operator runs both sides of a pair, honest reporting exposes its own second shell, while a clean report creates a delta a third auditor can catch against the vine of logged actions at the jetty where work docks. Honest singletons report freely; a sybil must either betray itself or forge consistently under re-pairing, making each extra identity a liability, not a multiplier.
